# Should yield items not seen in last 2
# Let's check: 
# 1 - not seen -> yield 1
# 2 - not seen in [1] -> yield 2
# 1 - seen in [1,2]? window is [2,1], 1 is in it -> don't yield
# 3 - not seen in [1,1]? window is [1,3], 3 is not in it -> yield 3
# 2 - seen in [1,3]? window is [3,2], 2 is not in it -> yield 2
# 1 - seen in [3,2]? window is [2,1], 1 is not in it -> yield 1

# partial_product

print(f'sieve(20) = {result}')
print('sieve works')
